name: Stormbringer: Blessing of Lei Shen heals for the Stormflow tick damage (#1342)
contract: #1342: Blessing of Lei Shen (561228) reads 'Damage dealt by Stormflow now heals you equal to the damage dealt'. Its only effect is APPLY_AURA with EffectApplyAuraName 354 on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, EffectTriggerSpell 561308 and EffectBasePoints 99 / DieSides 1 = 100 (%). Aura 354 has no core handler (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:419 is literally 'nullptr, //354 unknown Ascension aura') and 561228 has ProcFlags 0 with no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp:2257) and 561308 is never cast; its only incoming DBC link is 561228 itself. 561308 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER with base 0 -> 1 and SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, SPELL_ATTR4_IGNORE_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MODIFIERS and SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS, i.e. the amount is supplied by the caller. Stormflow is cast as rank 572867, the rank a level-80 Stormbringer owns (module progression grants 572861 from level 20 up to 572867 from level 68); it channels for 8000 ms (SpellDuration 31) and ticks every 1000 ms (EffectAmplitude 1000). The per-tick damage is $m1 + $SP*0.2 and therefore not a constant, and the harness only allows a ratio between snapshots of the same metric, so the 100 % coefficient is asserted structurally instead: one 561308 heal per Stormflow tick, with a heal total far above 561308's own base value. Rank 572867 has EffectBasePoints 187 / DieSides 10, i.e. at least 188 per tick before spell power, so four ticks carry at least 752; the floor of 100 is a conservative bound that still separates a damage-sized caller amount from the base value of 1 (8 ticks of it would total 8).

DISCRIMINATING: every Stormflow tick now casts 561308 on the caster
SETUP: the second channel dealt its 8 periodic ticks (8000 ms at 1000 ms)
DISCRIMINATING: one 561308 heal landed per Stormflow tick
